title: just-deliver approval record
description: Written by `jd approve`, one file per approval, never edited: the local evidence that the principal in `identity` approved the release set `release.setSha256` (label `release.label`) for the gated environment `environment`, which required it qualified on `qualifiedOn` (docs/architecture/approvals.md). It binds the set, not a record. `meaning` is what the approver asserts and is never interpreted.

environment.description: The gated environment approved for, as its descriptor names it.

setSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the label's kept set.yaml on `qualifiedOn`.

qualifiedOn.description: The environment whose records showed the set qualified, from the approval policy.

identity.description: The approving principal as Entra reports it, never as any file or variable claims.

meaning.description: What the approver asserts by approving, verbatim: 1 to 500 characters, no control characters.
